requirements.text: The approval mark described in paragraph 5.3 shall be affixed to every electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the approval route; if approved as ESAs, inspect each lamp for the approval mark per 5.3.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: If approved as ESAs, check the approval mark is present and placed as specified on the approval communication form.

requirements.text: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3 need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: If ESA approval applies, verify the mark is present on the lamp, noting that visibility after installation is not required.

requirements.text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review EMC test report and approval for the lamp as ESA/component per UN R10 emission and immunity limits.

requirements.text: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Check ESA EMC test reports for radiated/conducted emissions and immunity of each lamp.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Review the Annex 7 broadband radiated emission test report for a representative sample of each lamp.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit for the ESA in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 75 MHz and compare them with the limit line in Appendix 6.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit for the ESA in the 400 to 1,000 MHz band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 400 to 1000 MHz and confirm they stay below 63 dBuV/m.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit for the ESA in the 75 to 400 MHz band shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 75 to 400 MHz and compare them with the limit line in Appendix 6.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Check that all measured broadband values in the test report are below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 8 radiated narrowband emission measurement on a representative sample of each lamp and review the test report.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit for the ESA in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Compare the measured narrowband field strength at 30-75 MHz with the 52 to 42 dBµV/m limit line.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit for the ESA in the 400 to 1,000 MHz band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Check that the measured narrowband field strength at 400-1000 MHz stays below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit for the ESA in the 75 to 400 MHz band shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Compare the measured narrowband field strength at 75-400 MHz with the 42 to 53 dBµV/m limit line.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the measured dBµV/m values are below the limits across the full frequency range.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type, for vehicles with 12 V systems, shall have a maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of -100 V when tested according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the 12 V supply voltage, then test per ISO 7637-2 (Annex 10) and check that the negative pulse does not go below -100 V.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type, for vehicles with 12 V systems, shall have a maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of +75 V when tested according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the 12 V supply voltage, then test the transient emissions per ISO 7637-2 (Annex 10) and check that the positive pulse does not exceed +75 V.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type, for vehicles with 24 V systems, shall have a maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of -450 V when tested according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the system voltage; if 24 V, test per ISO 7637-2 (Annex 10) and check that the negative pulse does not go below -450 V.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type, for vehicles with 24 V systems, shall have a maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of +150 V when tested according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the system voltage; if 24 V, test per ISO 7637-2 (Annex 10) and check that the positive pulse does not exceed +150 V.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Check the EMC test report for radiated immunity testing of each lamp by an Annex 9 method.

requirements.text: The test severity for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report shows at least the Table 2b minimum level across the full 20-6000 MHz band.

requirements.text: The test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be as given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report shows the Table 2a field strength levels over more than 90% of 20-6000 MHz.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall show no degradation of performance of immunity related functions during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: During the radiated immunity test, monitor the light output and operation of each lamp and confirm there is no degradation.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 for pulse 1 at -75 V for 12 V systems and -450 V for 24 V systems, for 500 pulses, as described in Annex 10, with functional status classification III for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V), 500 pulses, per Annex 10; check for class III.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 for pulse 2a at +37 V for 12 V systems and +37 V for 24 V systems, for 500 pulses, as described in Annex 10, with functional status classification I for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a at +37 V, 500 pulses, per Annex 10; check for class I for immunity-related functions and class III for others.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 for pulse 2b at +10 V for 12 V systems and +20 V for 24 V systems, for 10 pulses, as described in Annex 10, with functional status classification II for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b at +10 V (12 V) or +20 V (24 V), 10 pulses, per Annex 10; check for class II for immunity-related functions and class III for others.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 for pulse 3a at -112 V for 12 V systems and -150 V for 24 V systems, for 1 h, as described in Annex 10, with functional status classification I for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V) or -150 V (24 V) for 1 h per Annex 10; check for class I for immunity-related functions and class III for others.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 for pulse 3b at +75 V for 12 V systems and +150 V for 24 V systems, for 1 h, as described in Annex 10, with functional status classification I for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V) for 1 h per Annex 10; check for class I for immunity-related functions and class III for others.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type that shall be operational during engine start phases shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile with 10 pulses, with the test levels given in Table 3a and functional status classification II.
requirements.test_case: Confirm powertrain and whether each lamp is lit during cranking; if so, test per ISO 16750-2 starting profile with 10 pulses at Table 3a levels, class II.

requirements.text: The immunity of other ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile, with the test levels given in Table 3a and functional status classification C.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the powertrain; if ICE, test per ISO 16750-2 starting profile at Table 3a levels, class C.

requirements.text: ESAs shall be permitted to comply with the requirements of the TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.test_case: Check the immunity test report for ISO 11452-3 TEM cell results and confirm they cover the full frequency range of paragraph 3.1.

requirements.text: ESAs shall be permitted to comply with the requirements of the absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.test_case: Check the immunity test report for ISO 11452-2 results and confirm they cover the full frequency range of paragraph 3.1.

requirements.text: ESAs shall be permitted to comply with the requirements of the bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.test_case: Check the immunity test report for ISO 11452-4 BCI results and confirm they cover the full frequency range of paragraph 3.1.

requirements.text: ESAs shall be permitted to comply with the requirements of the reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11, at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.test_case: Check the immunity test report for ISO 11452-11 reverberation chamber results and confirm they cover the full frequency range of paragraph 3.1.

requirements.text: ESAs shall be permitted to comply with the requirements of the stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5, at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.test_case: Check the immunity test report for ISO 11452-5 stripline results and confirm they cover the full frequency range of paragraph 3.1.

requirements.text: The test conditions for ESAs shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report for ISO 11452-1 test conditions.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Check the test setup documentation against the Annex arrangement.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that each lamp was energised and operating normally during the test.

requirements.text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit and the wiring harnesses as intended for use in the vehicle are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp design for separate control units and harnesses; if multi-unit, verify the harness length per the standard.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Confirm AM 1 kHz 80% modulation in 20-400 MHz in the report.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Confirm PM2 Ton 3 µs, period 3333 µs in 2700-3100 MHz.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.test_case: Confirm PM3 Ton 500 µs, period 1000 µs in 380-2700 and 3100-6000 MHz.

requirements.text: Measurements on the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the report covers 20-6000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 steps.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time of the measurements shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: No product test; lab procedure.

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz.
requirements.test_case: No product test; lab procedure.

requirements.text: Depending on the ESA to be tested, the Technical Service shall choose the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell.
requirements.test_case: Check the TEM cell test report for the coupling choice (ESA or harness maximum field coupling) made by the Technical Service.

requirements.text: The TEM cell test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
requirements.test_case: Check the immunity test report for a TEM cell test per ISO 11452-3, if that method is chosen.

requirements.text: As an alternative, the ESA shall be permitted to be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: If the in-vehicle route is used, check the ISO 11451-4 BCI test with the substitution method and the probe at 150 mm.

requirements.text: The bulk current injection (BCI) immunity test of the ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA; or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Check the BCI test report for the method (substitution at 150 mm or closed loop at 900 mm) and for ISO 11452-4 compliance.

requirements.text: The stripline immunity test of the ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.test_case: If the stripline method is used, check the test report for ISO 11452-5 compliance.

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber immunity test of the ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: If the reverberation chamber method is used, check the test report for ISO 11452-11 compliance.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
requirements.test_case: Check the reverberation chamber test report for a setup with ground plane.

requirements.text: ESAs shall be immune to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply, as ensured by this test method.
requirements.test_case: Run the Annex 10 transient immunity test on each lamp and check that performance is not degraded.

requirements.text: ESAs shall limit conducted transients emitted to the vehicle power supply, as ensured by this test method.
requirements.test_case: Measure the transients each lamp emits on the supply line per ISO 7637-2 and compare them with the limits.

requirements.text: The immunity test of ESAs against transients conducted along 12/24 V supply lines shall apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply lines and verify the lamp function.

requirements.text: The immunity test of ESAs against transients conducted along 12/24 V supply lines shall apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the supply and connected lines and verify the lamp function.

requirements.text: The emission measurement of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be made according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure the emitted transients per ISO 7637-2 on the supply and connected lines and compare them with the limits.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a marking area of sufficient size.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check of markings and a rub test with water and petrol.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for “a” of the approval marking shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure dimension a of the approval mark.

requirements.text: The sequential number of the approval marking shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the placement of the sequential number relative to the approval mark.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the arrow of the additional symbol shall be directed outwards from the vehicle for front or rear position lamps and front or rear end-outline marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the lamp is handed and whether the arrow points outwards.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the arrow of the additional symbol shall be directed outwards from the vehicle for reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the handedness and light distribution type, and the arrow direction.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the approval marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), the lamp shall bear a marking indicating also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documents and the lamp marking for substitute light source categories.

requirements.text: Lamps with replaceable light sources shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the light sources are replaceable and, if so, the category marking.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with a secondary operating mode, the lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Check the operating modes and the voltage marking.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with a variable luminous intensity control, the lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for intensity control and the voltage marking.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear, the lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for control gear and the voltage marking.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, the lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp for the rated voltage marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp for the module identification code.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear a specific identification code comprising the starting letters "MD" for "MODULE" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.
requirements.test_case: Check the module marking for the MD identification code.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Check the module for the rated voltage marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for replaceable modules and the trade name marking.

requirements.text: In case several non-identical light source modules are used, the approval mark on each light source module and the approval mark on the lamp in which the module is used shall be from the same applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check that the module and lamp approval marks come from the same applicant.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check for external control gear and its identification marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect where the marking is placed.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Check marking visibility on the vehicle with the boot lid or door opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for a detachable lens and for markings on both lens and body.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Check that each body bears only the markings of its own functions.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the required markings.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
requirements.test_case: Check that the module markings are on the module.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Check the mark component sizes against the minimum for each regulation.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval test report and the lamp's conformity against all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5 (photometry, colour, marking, etc.) for each lamp function.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Document check: map the applicable R48 (M1) section 5 and 6 requirements to each lamp function and verify them through the lamp type approval tests.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Document check: confirm for each lamp that all M1-relevant requirements verifiable at lamp approval are listed and tested in the approval test report.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Run the vibration test on the lamp assembly, then check that it still operates and that photometric and colorimetric values stay within the prescribed limits; review the design documents.

requirements.text: Front and rear position lamps which are grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated shall be permitted to be used as end-outline marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documentation for grouping or combination of the position lamp and its use as an end-outline marker.

requirements.text: Position lamps or daytime running lamps which are reciprocally incorporated with another function, using a common light source, and designed to operate permanently with an additional system to regulate the intensity of the light emitted, shall be permitted.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documentation for a common light source and an intensity regulation system.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle installation documentation for a failure tell-tale for these lamps.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp design to see whether position and stop use shared or separate LED light sources.

requirements.text: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., the logo of a lamp incorporating a manufacturer logo shall be only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: If a logo is present, check that it is the vehicle or body manufacturer's brand logo.

requirements.text: Notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 5.5.2. of UN Regulation No. 48, the logo light emitting surface (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) shall be permitted to be non-symmetrical by itself.
requirements.test_case: If a logo is present, check its shape against the logo provisions.

requirements.text: On request of the applicant, and provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) shall be permitted to incorporate only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the drawings and lens for any logo and confirm that the specific function requirements are still fulfilled.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the stop and reversing lamps to confirm no logo is in the optics or lens.

requirements.text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: If a logo is present, measure its enclosed light emitting surface along the reference axis (at most 100 cm2).

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Check the circuit schematic to see whether LED groups are wired so one failure extinguishes the group, and count the light sources.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, the lamp shall produce a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: If a lamp has several light sources, disable one and verify the lamp outputs the failure signal for the tell-tale.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3, and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp design for the number of light sources, then measure intensity with any one source failed against the Annex 3 minimum values and with all sources lit against the maximum.

requirements.text: In the case where the failure signal option is used for a single lamp containing more than one light source, a note in the communication form shall state that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.test_case: If the failure-signal option is used on a multi-source lamp, check the communication form for the note restricting use to vehicles fitted with a failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Check whether a variable intensity control exists; if so, simulate its failure and measure that the intensity stays within the R1 maximum.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Check whether a variable intensity control exists; if so, simulate its failure and measure that the intensity stays within the S1 maximum.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Check whether a variable intensity control exists; if so, simulate its failure and measure that the intensity stays within the S3 maximum.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Document check: light sources are approved replaceable sources, light source modules or non-replaceable sources per the communication form.

requirements.text: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the applicant for type approval of the lamp shall declare that the lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles, and this shall be noted in the communication form.
requirements.test_case: Check the application and communication form for any declared restriction of light source use.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Check the design drawings and a physical inspection to see whether the light sources are replaceable, and if so verify they cannot be fitted in any position but the correct one.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
requirements.test_case: Confirm whether the light sources are replaceable; if so, check the holder against IEC 60061 sheets via the datasheet or a gauge check.

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: EMC test of radiated and power line disturbances, checking that other vehicle systems are not disturbed.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: If the modules are replaceable, try to interchange them with other sources or modules in the same housing.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: If the modules are replaceable, check that they fit only in the correct position and need a tool to remove.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall be tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: If the modules are replaceable, inspect the tamperproof design.

requirements.text: When the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: If modules are replaceable, replace with a module of the same code and repeat the photometric measurements.

requirements.text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometric test report states the measurement conditions of 4.8.1.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documents for replaceable light sources; if present, check the report for standard light sources.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
requirements.test_case: Confirm light source type and control; if applicable, measure luminous flux at test voltage (within 5 per cent of reference).

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometric test report shows measurements with the LED modules fitted in the lamp.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., all separate measurement results shall be added together.
requirements.test_case: If mixed sources, check that separate results are summed in the report.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Check the light source configuration; if mixed, check separate measurements per condition.

requirements.text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometric test setup and report for masking against stray reflections.

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the application drawings for installation positions; if several, check photometry repeated at each or extreme positions.

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp, at the discretion of the applicant, also has to be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Check the application for substitute light source approval; if so, check repeated measurements.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Check the report shows intensities measured with the sources continuously lit.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined, and this requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the drawing and report define the apparent surface in the reference axis direction.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Check the report shows the test voltage matching the vehicle system voltage.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check the electrical design; if controlled, check the lamp was operated as specified by the applicant.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, for light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check the electrical design; if uncontrolled, check operation as specified by the applicant.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, for replaceable UN approved light source(s) the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
requirements.test_case: Check source type; if replaceable, check the flux operating point or intensity correction.

requirements.text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the lamp shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.
requirements.test_case: Check source configuration; if applicable, check flux deviation within 5 per cent of the average.

requirements.text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
requirements.test_case: If applicable, check proportional correction of intensities in the report.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement over the visible directions confirming intensity does not exceed the paragraph 5 maximum for each function.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of intensity on the HV axis for both samples versus the minimum in the paragraph 5 table for each function.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at grid directions and compare to the Annex 3 distribution figure percentages times the minimum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement within the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles versus the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Check measured intensity distribution against the Annex 3 local variation provisions.

requirements.text: If the applicant requests an additional test to verify visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the lamp shall show that in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum intensity is not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd.
requirements.test_case: If requested, measure max intensity at 165-180 deg outboard, -2.5 to +5 deg vertical, at most 0.25 cd.

requirements.text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, marked D and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the maximum intensity requirements if all lamps together are lit.
requirements.test_case: Check for a D-marked assembly; if so, measure max intensity with all lamps lit.

requirements.text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, marked D and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the minimum intensity requirements if either lamp has failed.
requirements.test_case: If D-marked, measure minimum intensity with either lamp failed.

requirements.text: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check for interdependent systems; if so, test with all lamps operated together.

requirements.text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.test_case: If split across a movable component, test at all fixed positions.

requirements.text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Check for variable intensity control; if present, verify output stays in paragraph 5 range.

requirements.text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensity exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp: under night-time conditions for systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions, or under standard conditions for other systems.
requirements.test_case: If present, measure max intensity under night/standard conditions against paragraph 5 maxima.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for reciprocal incorporation; if so, measure the stop to position ratio is at least 5:1 in the specified field.

requirements.text: If one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered shall be those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.test_case: If applicable, check values are taken with all sources operating.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report follows the Annex 8 procedures.

requirements.text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documentation for whether the LED modules are replaceable; if not, measure colour with the LEDs fitted per paragraph 4.8.

requirements.text: Outside the light distribution grid field of the specific function, the lamp shall show no sharp variation of colour.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect and measure colour outside the grid field for abrupt colour changes.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of each lamp within its Annex 3 grid field and compare with the colour limits for the function.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
requirements.test_case: Confirm from the bill of materials that each function uses only LED technology; otherwise check colour separately per technology.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps shall be permitted to have a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documents for reciprocal incorporation with the stop lamp; if present, measure intensity below the 5° downward plane.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both supplied samples against the Table 4 intensity limits.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility given in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric photometry of intensity at the Table 4 grid points within the geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) shall comply with the failure provisions in paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Review the design and check the failure behaviour per 4.6 (e.g. simulate LED failure).

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the emitted light and compare them with the red colour region.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of stop lamps shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Photometric test of two stop lamp samples against the Table 7 intensity values.

requirements.text: Stop lamps shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of luminous intensity within the Table 7 angles.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the emitted light and check they are within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The condition for pair installation of the reversing lamp shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents (see paragraph 3.1.).
requirements.test_case: Document check: if pair-only, confirm the application and related documents explain the pair condition.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples against Table 10 minimum and maximum intensities.

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Check the intended installation (pair or single) in the design documents; if pair-only, verify at least 25 cd up to 30° inwards.

requirements.text: Where the type approval is granted applying the pair condition, the reversing lamp shall only be installed in a pair, and this shall be stated in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1).
requirements.test_case: If pair approval is used, check that communication form 9.1.3 states pair-only installation and the vehicle fitment is in pairs.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of emitted light and check they fall within the white region.

requirements.text: The lamps listed in Table A2-1 (position, end-outline marker, stop, front and rear direction indicators, daytime running and front and rear parking lamps) shall have the minimum horizontal and vertical angles of geometric visibility given in Table A2-1 Angles of geometric visibility, horizontal and vertical.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp's visible illuminating surface against the Table A2-1 horizontal and vertical angles for the rear position and stop functions, using the installation drawings and a goniometric or visibility check.

requirements.text: The minimum intensities expressed as percentages of the minimum intensities required, as given in Figures A3-I to A3-XV, shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Check that the minimum intensity values used in the photometric test are rounded down to three significant digits.

requirements.text: Where one of these lamps is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's declared H-plane mounting height; if at or below 750 mm, verify photometry only up to 5° downwards.

requirements.text: The light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines of the light distribution shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; intensity in each grid field is at least the lowest surrounding grid percentage.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Visually examine the lamp; if local variations appear, measure that no intensity between directions is below 50% of the lower adjacent minimum.

requirements.text: Front and rear position lamps, parking lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, stop lamps (S1, S2 and MS), and direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12 shall meet the standard light distribution shown in Figure A3-I, with minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
requirements.test_case: Confirm lamp category, then measure intensities against Figure A3-I percentages and Table minima.

requirements.text: Category S3 and S4 stop lamps shall meet the light distribution shown in Figure A3-III, with minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7).
requirements.test_case: Confirm stop lamp category; if S3/S4 measure against Figure A3-III.

requirements.text: Reversing lamps shall meet the minimum intensities in cd for the various directions of measurement shown in figure A3-V.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the reversing lamp against the cd values in Figure A3-V.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensities after 1 min and 10 min of operation and compare with the min/max values.

requirements.text: For all other lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensities at 1 min and at 30 min or photometric stability and compare with the limits.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the lamp (function) shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the intensity distribution at the Table A8-1 point in time for LED technology.

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) shall be deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2 are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Verify the paragraph 1.2 measurements comply for each lamp.

requirements.text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
requirements.test_case: Record intensity from switch-on to photometric stability and check minimum intensity at all points in time if run-up is unexpected.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device for a marking space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings.

requirements.text: All markings on the retro-reflective device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check of legibility; rub test with water and petroleum spirit for indelibility.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Check that the approval marking is a four to six-digit sequential number matching the approval certificate.

requirements.text: The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: If a UI is used, compare the mark format with Figure I.

requirements.text: The approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. shall be permitted to be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available.
requirements.test_case: Document check whether a Unique Identifier is used in place of the approval marking.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: A retro-reflective device that is a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA shall bear the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's rotation angle prescription and whether the word TOP is marked horizontally on the highest part.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of marking legibility on the device.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in those sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Document check of applicable UN R48 sections 5 and 6 requirements.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Document check of requirements for category M1.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect and run durability/normal-use tests per R150 to confirm satisfactory function over time.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of samples for design or manufacturing defects.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector by hand and check for design evidence such as welded or bonded joints.

requirements.text: Any protuberances on the outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any protuberances on the outer surface and check that cleaning is not hindered.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer surface and perform a cleaning check.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface for roughness.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed or mounted retro-reflector to confirm the inner surface cannot be reached.

requirements.text: Retro-reflectors shall be permitted to consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter.
requirements.test_case: Check the drawings to see whether a filter is combined with the optical unit.

requirements.text: The combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter of a retro-reflector shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: If a filter is present, attempt separation and check the design documents.

requirements.text: Retro-reflecting optical units and filters shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.test_case: Check the material specification and inspect for paint or varnish coloration.

requirements.text: The night-time colour specifications of this Regulation shall apply only to white, red or amber retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Check the retro-reflector's declared colour (white, red or amber) in the drawings and approval documents.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0°, or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of the retro-reflected light with Illuminant A at 1/3° divergence and β1=β2=0° (or the Annex 4 angle if the surface reflection is colourless).

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected light and compare them with the UN R48 colour limits.

requirements.text: White retro-reflective devices shall not produce a selective reflection, that is to say, the trichromatic coordinates "x" and "y" of Standard Illuminant "A" used to illuminate the retro-reflective device shall not undergo a change of more than 0.01 after reflection by the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: If white, measure x,y of Illuminant A before and after reflection and confirm the change is at most 0.01.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Check dimensions and shape against Annex 5.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Photometric RI and colour measurement per 5.1.4 and 5.1.5.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Run the physical and mechanical tests of 5.1.7.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure colour after the tests and compare with 5.1.5.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have an RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 20' divergence and β=0 after the tests.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI against Table 3 values.

requirements.text: Within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°), the RI values of Class IA and Class IB retro-reflectors shall not be lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI within the solid angle against Table 3 last columns.

requirements.text: Where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check mounting height; limit RI verification to 5° downward if below 750 mm.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates and compare with UN R48 limits.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the retro-reflector class on the drawings, then inspect the illuminating surface shape from 10 m to check it is not easily confused with a triangle.

requirements.text: After the 48-hour test at 65 °C ± 2 °C, the sample of the retro-reflective device shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: After the 48 h heat exposure, confirm the sample is cooled for 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C before the inspection.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the retro-reflector class on the approval documents, then keep the sample for 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C in a dry atmosphere.

requirements.text: After the heat resistance test of Annex 6 Part 1, the retro-reflective device, and in particular its optical component, shall show no cracking or appreciable distortion.
requirements.test_case: After the heat test and cooling, visually inspect the prism optics for cracking or appreciable distortion.

requirements.text: Immediately after the 50 °C immersion, the sample units shall be immersed in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C under the same immersion conditions as the 50 °C immersion (10 minutes, highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the surface of the water).
requirements.test_case: Immediately after the 50 °C immersion, immerse the retro-reflector for 10 min in water at 25±5 °C under the same conditions, and check the report.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices, whether part of a lamp or not, or sample units of retro-reflective marking, shall be immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Immerse the retro-reflector for 10 min at 50±5 °C with the top of the illuminating surface 20 mm under water, and record the result.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices, whether part of a lamp or not, or sample units of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts before the water immersion test.
requirements.test_case: Check the water immersion test report to confirm removable parts were stripped from the retro-reflector before immersion.

requirements.text: When the 50 °C immersion test is repeated, the retro-reflective device shall be turned through 180° so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: If the 50 °C immersion is repeated, turn the retro-reflector 180° so the illuminating surface is down, with about 20 mm of water over the rear face, and verify in the report.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after the immersion test, and fail it if water is clearly present.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit of the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: After immersion, inspect the reflecting surface of the retro-reflector's optical unit for water ingress.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors, where visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, with the retro-reflective device first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: Shake lightly and measure RI per 5.1.3.2.2; compare with pre-test values.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests shall be applied to the retro-reflective devices of Classes IB and IIIB.
requirements.test_case: Check the retro-reflector class on the approval documents and whether the manufacturer requested the alternative tests.

requirements.text: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray as follows.
requirements.test_case: Run the water spray test and compare RI before and after.

requirements.text: All drain holes and other openings of the sample device shall remain open.
requirements.test_case: Check that drain holes and openings are left open during the test.

requirements.text: When drain wicks are used, they shall be tested in the device.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for drain wicks and fit them in the test sample.

requirements.text: The device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min -1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the rotation rate is 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1 during the test.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp functions on the 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle during the test.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Confirm the spray runs for 12 cycles of 5/55 min.

requirements.text: The rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
requirements.test_case: Check the 1 h drain period with the door closed.

requirements.text: After the exterior of the retro-reflective device has been dried with a dry cotton cloth, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Document check that the lab dried the exterior and measured RI per Annex 4 Part 1 after the water test.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period of the water spray test in Annex 6 Part 3 paragraph 2.2, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed in the retro-reflective device, or one which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: After the drain period, check for standing water, then tap and tilt the device and check again; no pool may form.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period of the water spray test in Annex 6 Part 3 paragraph 2.2, the interior of the retro-reflective device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
requirements.test_case: After the water spray and drain period, inspect the interior of the retro-reflector for moisture accumulation and record the result.

requirements.text: The test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test dust is cement per ASTM C 150-84.

requirements.text: A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows.
requirements.test_case: Expose the mounted sample to dust and compare RI against the initial value.

requirements.text: All drain holes and other openings of the sample device shall remain open.
requirements.test_case: Check that drain holes and openings are left open during the dust test.

requirements.text: When drain wicks are used, they shall be tested in the device.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for drain wicks and fit them in the test sample.

requirements.text: The dust exposure shall be carried out for the duration of 5 hours.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the dust exposure lasts 5 hours.

requirements.text: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s.
requirements.test_case: Check the agitation of 2 to 15 s every 15 min during the test.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 after the dust test and compare with the limits.

requirements.text: Particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked, the resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of its rear face to deterioration shall be checked.
requirements.test_case: Check the bill of materials for essential metal components; if present, inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear protection for deterioration.
