requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Review the salt mist test report and check photometry (RA and colour) after the test.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts before the saline mist test.
requirements.test_case: Check the corrosion test report shows removable parts were removed from the retro-reflector sample before saline mist exposure.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Expose the retro-reflector to saline mist for 2 periods of 24 h separated by 2 h drying, then check for corrosion affecting the device and its photometric performance.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Confirm whether metal components exist; if so, verify the salt mist atomizing temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C in the test record.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline solution shall be obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Confirm whether metal components exist; if so, check the saline solution is 5 parts NaCl in 95 parts distilled water with at most 0.02% impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the salt mist test for corrosion that impairs efficiency.

requirements.text: Before measuring, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
requirements.test_case: Check in the test report that salt deposits were removed from the surface before the RA measurement.

requirements.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.test_case: Measure RA at β2=5° and α=20' after 48 h recovery and compare with Tables 9 and 10.

requirements.text: The reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for a mirror-backed (metallized) rear face; if present, brush the rear face with a hard nylon brush per Annex 6 Part 5.

requirements.text: After the cotton cloth has been removed, the retro-reflective device shall be left to dry.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report records the drying of the device after cloth removal.

requirements.text: After the one-minute application, the cotton cloth shall be removed from the rear face of the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report records the cloth removal after the one-minute application.

requirements.text: After the rear face of the retro-reflective device has been brushed, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report records the one-minute cloth application with the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA, the rear face of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed before the cotton cloth is applied.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows the rear face was brushed before the cloth test, if the reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastic Class IA/IB/IIIA/IIIB/IVA.

requirements.text: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
requirements.test_case: If the test applies, after evaporation brush the rear face again with the same brush.

requirements.text: The RI of the mirror-backed retro-reflective device shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
requirements.test_case: If mirror-backed, cover the whole rear face with Indian ink and measure RI per 5.1.3.2.2.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Verify the weathering exposure lasted 500 h and review the test report.

requirements.text: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1.
requirements.test_case: Expose samples per EN ISO 4892-2 with Table A6-1 parameters, then check the post-test photometric and visual requirements.

requirements.text: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either: a retro-reflective device; or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking material.
requirements.test_case: Apply the 70/30 n-heptane/toluol mixture to a sample retro-reflector and check the result against the surface criteria.

requirements.text: After about five minutes, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer surface visually after about 5 minutes and record any changes.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the outer surface with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture and record the exposure.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: After the fuel wipe, inspect the surface for apparent changes; only slight cracks are acceptable.

requirements.text: After about 5 minutes, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface shall be cleaned.
requirements.test_case: Not a product requirement; verified through the lab's execution of the Annex 7 Part 2 test.

requirements.text: After the surface has been cleaned, the RI shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Expose the sample to detergent lubricating oil, clean it, measure RI per 5.1.3.2.2 and compare to the minimum values.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.test_case: Not a product requirement; verified through the lab's execution of the Annex 7 Part 2 test.

requirements.text: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps of the lighting and light-signalling devices to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mounting and any adjustment means to confirm no unintended displacement is possible; check the design drawings for fixing and locking.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Vibration test or installation inspection on the vehicle, then recheck photometric and positional characteristics against the prescribed values.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with for the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer fitting instructions, if any, and check that the installation complies with them.

requirements.text: In each direction, a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed on the reference axis of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed reference axis deviation in the horizontal and vertical directions and confirm it is within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road when the lamp is fitted to the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle installation drawing and measure the reference axis angle relative to the bearing plane.

requirements.text: The reference axis of all other signalling devices shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when fitted to the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the installation drawing and measure the reference axis angle relative to the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.test_case: With the vehicle unladen on a flat horizontal surface in normal condition of use (2.3.10), measure the height and orientation of each lamp and compare with the R48 installation limits.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle installation drawing for left/right positions relative to the median longitudinal plane, based on exterior lamp geometry.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the left and right lamp exterior geometry in the drawings or by inspection; the interior structure is excluded.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the left and right lamps against the colour limits for the function.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare goniophotometric intensity of the left and right lamps.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamps and lenses for any logo and confirm it is a vehicle or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo shall be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the rear of the vehicle for the number and placement of logos (two lateral or one central).

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the above requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Check vehicle shape; if asymmetrical, verify installation requirements are met as far as possible.

requirements.text: Lamps shall be permitted to be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation for colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and wiring of each grouped function.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Photometric and colorimetric test of each lamp with all other grouped functions off.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for reciprocal incorporation; if present, measure the colour of the other functions with the position lamp ON.

requirements.text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.test_case: Design review to confirm the stop lamp does not share light sources or apparent surface with a direction indicator.

requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour.
requirements.test_case: If grouped, check that horizontal and vertical lines cross no more than two colour borderlines in projection.

requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, shall not overlap.
requirements.test_case: If grouped, check that the apparent surfaces do not overlap along the reference axis.

requirements.text: A single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed such that the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure the gap between facing edges of adjacent parts perpendicular to the reference axis (max 75 mm).

requirements.text: A single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed such that the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Project the apparent surface and check that its area is at least 60% of the circumscribing quadrilateral.

requirements.text: A single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed such that the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: If two reflectors are used, measure the gap between facing edges (max 75 mm).

requirements.text: A single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed such that the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: If two reflectors are used, check that the projected surfaces fill at least 60% of the circumscribing quadrilateral.

requirements.text: A lamp in the shape of a band or strip shall be permitted to be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: No test; permissive rule.

requirements.text: A single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d), shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Document check that no lamp is marked Y.

requirements.text: Two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces included into the same lamp body and/or having a common outer lens shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the lamp body and outer lens to confirm they are not treated as an interdependent system.

requirements.text: The illumination of a lamp in the shape of a band or strip shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp shape; no test if not a band or strip.

requirements.text: The light-emitting surface of a lamp in the shape of a band or strip shall be permitted to be constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements on condition that these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane, fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp shape; no test if not a band or strip.

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be not less than 0.8 m long.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp shape; no test if not a band or strip.

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp shape; no test if not a band or strip.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground of a lamp shall be measured from the highest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Check the installation drawing: the maximum height is taken at the highest point of the apparent surface along the reference axis and is within the limits for each device.

requirements.text: The minimum height above the ground of a lamp shall be measured from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Check the installation drawing: the minimum height is taken at the lowest point of the apparent surface along the reference axis and is within the limits for each device.

requirements.text: Where the maximum and minimum height above the ground of a lamp clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.test_case: Review the height data: confirm heights clearly meet the limits, otherwise determine the exact apparent surface edges.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the visibility angles are reduced; if so, verify the height is measured from the H plane.

requirements.text: The position of a lamp as regards width, when referred to the distance between lamps, shall be determined from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Check the drawing: the spacing between lamps is measured between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces and meets the limits.

requirements.text: The position of a lamp as regards width, when referred to the overall width of the vehicle, shall be determined from the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the drawing: the width position is taken from the outer edge of the apparent surface, the edge furthest from the median plane, and meets the limits.

requirements.text: Where the position of a lamp as regards width clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.test_case: Review the width position data: confirm it clearly meets the limits, otherwise determine the exact apparent surface edges.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each lamp and check that intensity, colour and apparent surface stay constant while switched ON.

requirements.text: Direction-indicator lamps, the vehicle-hazard warning signal, amber side-marker lamps complying with paragraph 6.18.7., and the emergency stop signal shall be flashing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the specification and wiring for emergency stop signal function; if present, verify the lamp flashes when the signal is given.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp shall be permitted to vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: If any variation is implemented, verify the lamp still meets its photometric requirements across all states.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installed vehicle/photometric check that no red light from the rear position and stop lamps is visible from the front.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Visual observation test within Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle per Annex 4.

requirements.text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Confirm the reversing lamp is classed as a reversing lamp (exempt) and check that no other white light is visible from Zone 2 at 25 m behind.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity toward the front at type approval and confirm it is no more than 0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps (if they exist), the side-marker lamps (if they exist) and the rear registration plate lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review the wiring diagram and operate the lighting switch, checking that the rear position lamp, front position lamps and rear registration plate lamp switch ON and OFF together.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documentation to see whether the position lamp forms an interdependent lamp system; if so, switch it on and off and confirm all light sources respond simultaneously.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of emitted light against red limits.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of emitted light against white colour limits and check the spec.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of emitted light against red limits.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Check the reflector colour against red limits and its shape in the drawings.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Check the reflector shape in the drawings and its colour.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle (or installation drawing) and count the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors against the quantities in the UN R48 individual specifications (paragraphs 5.x for each device).

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle that, with movable components (e.g. tailgate) in any fixed position other than normal use, no more than 50% of the lamp's apparent surface along the reference axis is hidden.

requirements.text: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the lamps listed in paragraph 5.21 shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check vehicle design for movable components hiding the lamp and, if so, verify additional lamps switch ON and meet position, visibility, colour and photometric requirements.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.test_case: If the lamp can be more than 50% hidden, verify the vehicle carries a notice warning the user to warn other road users.

requirements.text: If applicable, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensity ratio between the lamps throughout the variation transitions.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control shall be permitted to respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1 and 5.26.2, provided that the conditions (a) and (b) of paragraph 5.26 are met.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documents for variable intensity control and for simultaneous response to the 5.26.1/5.26.2 conditions.

requirements.text: Where variable luminous intensity control applies under paragraph 5.26, the intensity of all the lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensities of the lamps across the control range and confirm they vary together in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity of the rear direction indicator lamps, rear position lamps and stop lamps with variable luminous intensity control under paragraph 5.26 shall be permitted to be increased or decreased, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, in relation to the following conditions: (a) ambient lighting, (b) fog, (c) snowfall, (d) rain, (e) spray, (f) dust clouds, (g) contamination of the light emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Review the control strategy and verify intensities stay within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulations under each condition.

requirements.text: An intensity decrease already activated under paragraph 5.26.2 shall be permitted to remain active as long as the vehicle speed is equal to or less than 50 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Test the control logic to confirm an active decrease persists only up to 50 km/h.

requirements.text: Independent from the environmental conditions mentioned under paragraph 5.26.1, the luminous intensity of the rear direction indicator lamps, rear position lamps and stop lamps with variable luminous intensity control under paragraph 5.26 shall be permitted to be decreased, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, as long as the vehicle speed is equal to or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal to or less than 20 m.
requirements.test_case: Check that any decrease at 20 km/h or 20 m or less stays within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulations.

requirements.text: Stop lamps of category S4 and rear fog lamps of category F2 shall be permitted to produce variable luminous intensity, based on the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1 and 5.26.2, independently from the other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the stop lamp category in the documents and, if S4, check that its independent variable intensity meets 5.26.1 and 5.26.2.

requirements.text: The variable luminous intensity functions of the lamps under paragraphs 5.26.1 to 5.26.3 shall be permitted to be set by the driver to static luminous intensities.
requirements.test_case: Check the driver setting option for static luminous intensity, if the variable functions are present.

requirements.text: The variable luminous intensity of the lamps under paragraph 5.26 shall not show any sharp variation of intensity during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record the intensity during transitions and verify there is no sharp variation.

requirements.text: The inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the lamp shall be free of any obstacle to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity; however, no account is taken of obstacles if they were already present when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Check the installed vehicle for obstructions inside the geometric visibility angles, viewed from infinity, for each device.

requirements.text: When the lamp is installed and any part of its apparent surface is hidden by further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle whether any apparent surface is hidden; if so, check photometric proof for the unhidden part.

requirements.text: When the lamp is at less than 750 mm above the ground, measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1, the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal shall be permitted to be reduced to 5 degrees.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed lamp height above ground per 5.8.1 and check the vertical visibility angle.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal is reduced to 5 degrees, the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit shall be permitted to be reduced to 5 degrees below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: If the 5 degree reduction is used, check the photometric field of the installed unit is limited to 5 degrees below horizontal.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documents for interdependence; if interdependent, check visibility with all interdependent lamps operated together.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check that each part has a valid type-approval mark and certificate under its device Regulation (R7/R87/R6/R23/R3 or equivalent).

requirements.text: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lens and housing drawings and samples for a manufacturer logo; if one is present, verify UN R148 approval.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.test_case: Check that the vehicle is fitted with a reversing lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp installation on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm shall be permitted to include a second reversing lamp device.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle has no more than two reversing lamp devices.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp installation on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm shall include one reversing lamp device.
requirements.test_case: Count reversing lamp devices on the vehicle: at least one.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2 shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking/certificate to R23 (00+) or R148 (00+).

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mounted not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the lamp above ground: 250 to 1200 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to confirm the lamp is at the rear.

requirements.text: If there are two reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, they shall have a geometric visibility angle β, as defined in paragraph 2.10.7., of 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.test_case: If two devices, check β of 45° outwards and 30° inwards.

requirements.text: If there is only one reversing lamp device installed at the rear of the vehicle, it shall have a geometric visibility angle β, as defined in paragraph 2.10.7., of 45° to right and to left.
requirements.test_case: If single device, check β of 45° left and right.

requirements.text: Reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall have a geometric visibility angle α, as defined in paragraph 2.10.7., of 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility angles α of 15° up and 5° down.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: lamp ON only with reverse engaged and ignition/propulsion on.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the conditions for switching ON is not satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Disengage reverse or switch propulsion off and check lamp goes OFF.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component regulation (R23/R148) for tell-tale requirement and verify fitment.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be permitted to have a tell-tale.
requirements.test_case: If a tell-tale is fitted, verify it operates as designed.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking or datasheet for the stop lamp category (S1/S2) and confirm it is fitted.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S3 or S4 categories shall be mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp category in the datasheet; if S3/S4 (central high-mounted), verify it is fitted on the M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: All categories of vehicles shall have one S3 or S4 category stop lamp device.
requirements.test_case: Check lamp category and count of S3/S4 devices.

requirements.text: All categories of vehicles shall have two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices.
requirements.test_case: Inspect vehicle for two S1/S2 stop lamps.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check approval marking and certificate to UN R7 02 series or R148.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the S1 or S2 stop lamp device whose apparent surface points, in the direction of the reference axis, farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure distance from outermost apparent surface point to vehicle extreme edge (<=400 mm).

requirements.text: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Measure offset of centre of reference from median plane (<=150 mm).

requirements.text: In the case where two S3 or S4 category devices are installed according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
requirements.test_case: Confirm category and measure positions relative to median plane.

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the optional stop lamps of S1 or S2 categories shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle lamp layout for optional lamps and verify height, width and symmetry compatibility.

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the optional stop lamps of S1 or S2 categories shall be positioned at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.test_case: If optional lamps are fitted, measure the vertical distance to the mandatory lamps (at least 600 mm).

requirements.text: If the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed, stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be positioned above the ground at not more than 2,100 mm.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle drawing for the mounting height and bodywork constraint; measure the height not exceeding 2100 mm.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be positioned above the ground at not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the lamp's illuminating surface lower and upper edges above ground at the laden vehicle condition.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 category devices, the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface shall either not be more than 150 mm below the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the exposed surface of the glass or glazing of the rear window, or not be less than 850 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Confirm category; measure lower edge height vs rear window or ground.

requirements.text: The horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of an S3 or S4 category device shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of S1 or S2 category devices.
requirements.test_case: Verify S3/S4 lower edge is above S1/S2 upper edge.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 stop lamp devices shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation position on vehicle.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° shall be permitted to be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height; verify inward angle.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 stop lamp devices shall have geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility angles on vehicle.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 stop lamp devices shall have geometric visibility of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify visibility angles per paragraph 5.8 on vehicle.

requirements.text: The S3 or S4 stop lamp devices shall have geometric visibility of 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Confirm category; verify 10° up and 5° down visibility.

requirements.text: The S3 or S4 stop lamp devices shall have geometric visibility of 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Confirm category; verify 10° horizontal visibility.

requirements.text: Where an S1 or S2 stop lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° shall be permitted to be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height; verify downward angle.

requirements.text: Where an optional S1 or S2 stop lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the upward angle of 15° shall be permitted to be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check if optional lamp above 2100 mm; verify upward angle.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect orientation of the reference axis on the vehicle.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Actuate service brake and verify all stop lamps light simultaneously.

requirements.text: The stop lamp tell-tale indicating failure shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check R7/R148 for failure tell-tale requirement and verify on vehicle.

requirements.text: The S3 or S4 category device shall not be reciprocally incorporated with any other lamp.
requirements.test_case: Confirm category; check no reciprocal incorporation with other lamps.

requirements.text: The S3 or S4 category device shall be permitted to be installed outside or inside the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Confirm category and installation location.

requirements.text: Rear position lamp devices of R, R1 or R2 categories shall be fitted.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp's marking and approval documents for category R, R1 or R2.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps shall be two in number.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to confirm two rear position lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval certificate and marking for UN R7 02+ or UN R148 00+.

requirements.text: For mandatory rear position lamps, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the apparent surface to the vehicle's outer edge.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be placed above the ground not less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm, or not more than 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the lamp's lowest and highest points above the ground.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to confirm the lamp is installed at the rear.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall provide a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility angles on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall provide a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Check vertical geometric visibility angles on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° shall be permitted to be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height and check the downward angle.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° shall be permitted to be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height and check the inward angle.

requirements.text: As an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp on M1 and N1 category vehicles shall provide a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Check for a side-marker lamp, then check the vertical angles.

requirements.text: As an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp on M1 and N1 category vehicles shall provide a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Check whether a rear side-marker lamp is fitted, then check the 45°/45° visibility.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp on M1 and N1 category vehicles shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, and the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
requirements.test_case: Measure the unobstructed apparent surface area in the reference axis direction.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp on M1 and N1 category vehicles is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° shall be permitted to be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check the mounting height and the downward angle.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp on M1 and N1 category vehicles is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° shall be permitted to be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Check the mounting height and the inward angle.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it shall be permitted to be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp design for reciprocal incorporation and test switching during indicator operation.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be electrically connected in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Check the wiring diagram and function test against 5.11.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be provided if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component regulation (R7/R148) for a failure tell-tale requirement and verify it.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamp shall be provided and combined with that of the front position lamps, except when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle for a combined tell-tale and test it with the lamps on.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Check that the vehicle is fitted with the rear retro-reflector pair.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials, including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below, shall be permitted to be fitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any additional retro-reflecting devices and confirm they do not impair mandatory lamp effectiveness.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector installation shall consist of two retro-reflectors type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings and the count of retro-reflectors against UN R3 or R150.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outermost point of the illuminating surface to the vehicle's outer edge (at most 400 mm).

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height above ground (250 to 900 mm, or the grouped or bodywork limits).

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the retro-reflector is mounted at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall provide a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check that the retro-reflector is visible within 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall provide a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Check that the retro-reflector is visible within 10° above and below horizontal.

requirements.text: Where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° shall be permitted to be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height; if it is below 750 mm, verify a downward angle of at least 5°.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector shall be permitted to have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Inspect whether the illuminating surface is shared with another rear lamp's apparent surface and confirm that the sharing is permitted.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle electrical specification for emergency stop signal activation of all stop lamps simultaneously.
